args.command: git ls-files '*.go' | xargs awk '/Store\.CreateMemo/ {print FILENAME ":" FNR ":" $0}'

python3 -c 'import os; root="server/router/api"; [(print(os.path.join(d,f)), None) for d,_,fs in os.walk(root) for f in fs if f.endswith(".go") and "Store.CreateMemo" in open(os.path.join(d,f), encoding="utf-8").read()]'
